description: Retrospective application for erection of a two storey side extension and side and rear roof dormers to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01 (Existing Block Plan), 01 
(Proposed Block Plan), 02, 05 (Existing First and Second Floor Plan), 05 (Proposed First and Second Floor Plan), 07 (Existing Front and Rear Elevations), 07 (Proposed Front and Rear Elevations), 08 (Existing Right & Left Elevation), 08 (Proposed Existing Right & Left Elevation), 10 (Existing Roof Plan), 10 (Proposed Roof Plan), received 25/07/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building: brickwork and roof tiles for the side extension and roof tiles for the cheeks of the two dormers.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the side dormer hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
